inferred_or_tuned.line_search: Common product Armijo; source provides backtracking citation, not constants or block coupling.
inferred_or_tuned.initialization: Portable Park-Miller phases, independent positive simplex entries then row normalization; seed not published.
inferred_or_tuned.scheduling_recovery: Largest relaxed entry, smallest index on exact tie; paper specifies thresholding but not its threshold.
inferred_or_tuned.non_descent: Raw per-block PR coefficients and raw slope are preserved and recorded. Full defaults use a documented gradient restart only for a non-descent total direction; this safeguard is not printed. literal_printed can instead terminate with a diagnostic.
inferred_or_tuned.distance: Ambient product norm for outer step; intrinsic product distance not numerically specified.
inferred_or_tuned.angles: Azimuth endpoints 30 to 70 degrees; elevation cell midpoints within 0 to 90 degrees avoid physically duplicate theta=0 targets. Original exact samples not published.
inferred_or_tuned.closed_form_origin: MS2 quadratic coordinates shifted by the maximum index span; physical displacement equals shift index minus maximum. This inferred origin/orientation aligns the published positive quadratic with ordinary-transpose G in the positive-angle region.
inferred_or_tuned.stopping: Numerical paragraph AND chosen explicitly; Algorithm 2 says OR. Both retained as selectable options.
inferred_or_tuned.feasibility: 1e-6 max q feasibility tolerance selected; original best-feasible numerical tolerance absent.
inferred_or_tuned.pslr: Guard 5 degrees Euclidean angular distance, clutter beta equal targets, epsilon 1e-12 and mu 10 halved to 1e-3 are inferred settings; original 60x60 grid retained.
inferred_or_tuned.ris_baseline: Independent phase optimization per target by same RALM/RCG, continuous design followed by nearest phase quantization for 1-bit/2-bit. Original baseline optimizer not specified.
inferred_or_tuned.grids: Sweep point grids recovered from EPS axis ticks/legends and integer geometry. These may differ from unpublished intermediate plotting samples.
